subject.title: fix(discord): default account env fallback when accounts.default.token is blank

question: Should Discord `accounts.default.token: ""` inherit `channels.discord.token` and `DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN` like an absent default token, or remain an explicit blank-token opt-out?
rationale: Current docs support default-account env fallback, but current code and SecretRef tests treat an explicit blank default token as suppressing inherited credentials; that compatibility choice needs maintainer intent before the branch is merged.

options.title: Adopt fallback for default blanks
options.body: Update resolver, account/setup inspection, SecretRef runtime-surface expectations, and any needed docs so only non-default blank tokens opt out.

options.title: Keep blank-token opt-out
options.body: Preserve current semantics and replace or close this PR in favor of a different fix for accidental generated blank stubs.

options.title: Migrate accidental blank stubs
options.body: Keep runtime semantics strict but add a doctor/setup migration that removes unintended blank default-account token stubs before runtime.

recommendation.title: Adopt fallback for default blanks
recommendation.body: Update resolver, account/setup inspection, SecretRef runtime-surface expectations, and any needed docs so only non-default blank tokens opt out.
